items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: You remember those Bebe used to play drum with y'all in the brass band? ... Yeah, I remember him.

ctx.x: Oh, no. He died longer than that.

Well, I'm working on this one particular band. He's dead longer than that. I'm going to get this straight. Huh? They had a, let's see. In the own what band, they had Matthews on drums. Hmm? Hmm? Matthews. That's it.
Yeah, Matthews on drums. Did Matthews ever play any drum in the Onward Band?
